description: This PHP class 'UserModel' defines a data model for representing user information in the OrangeHRM system's API. It uses annotations for OpenAPI schema generation and implements serialization traits to handle conversion of User entities into structured API responses, including related employee and role details.

classes.name: UserModel
classes.description: Defines a serializable API model for user entities, including related employee and role data, with OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UserModel with a User entity and configures which attributes and relations to serialize.
